description: Microsoft Graph app role (RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory) - grant any Entra directory role, including Global Administrator, from a service principal.
prerequisite_privilege: A service principal holding the RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory app role
abuse_primitive: Graph POST to add a principal to a privileged directoryRole (e.g. Global Administrator) - the classic app-based privilege escalation.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add member to role' / 'Add eligible member to role' (directory logging default-on).
A privileged-role grant to a risky principal can surface in Entra ID Protection / privileged-role-change alerting.
Defender for Cloud Apps flags privileged directory-role additions.

notes: Granting a privileged role is high-signal and default-logged; a first-party product (ID Protection) plus SIEM commonly alert on it. Loudest of the AZMG family.
